meta.description: IgA nephropathy keyword clusters. Spans the post-2021 drug landscape (Tarpeyo / Filspari / Fabhalta / Vanrafia plus Ph3 APRIL-pathway pipeline), Oxford MEST-C biopsy classification, the synpharyngitic-hematuria presenting pattern, RASi + SGLT2i supportive-care backbone, and the proteinuria-surrogate-endpoint debate that shaped recent accelerated approvals. Parent_theme / parent_subtheme reference the codebook.json @ 2.0 taxonomy.

clusters.label: ACE inhibitor / ARB (RAS blockade)
clusters.description: Renin-angiotensin system blockers — lisinopril, losartan, ramipril, irbesartan — the supportive-care backbone for IgAN, used to lower proteinuria and blood pressure.

clusters.label: SGLT2 inhibitors (dapagliflozin / empagliflozin)
clusters.description: SGLT2 inhibitors added on top of RAS blockade for kidney protection in IgAN — dapagliflozin (Farxiga) carries a CKD label, empagliflozin (Jardiance) follows via EMPA-KIDNEY.

clusters.label: Budesonide ER (Tarpeyo / Kinpeygo)
clusters.description: Targeted-release budesonide acting on Peyer's patches of the distal ileum — the first IgAN-specific approval (US Tarpeyo 2021/full 2023, EU Kinpeygo). 9 mg daily x 9 months.

clusters.label: Sparsentan (Filspari)
clusters.description: Dual endothelin-A and angiotensin II receptor antagonist for IgAN; accelerated approval 2023, full approval 2024 on the PROTECT trial. Travere Therapeutics.

clusters.label: Iptacopan (Fabhalta)
clusters.description: Oral factor B inhibitor of the complement alternative pathway, approved for IgAN in late 2024 on APPLAUSE-IgAN. Novartis.

clusters.label: Atrasentan (Vanrafia)
clusters.description: Selective endothelin-A receptor antagonist approved for IgAN in 2025 on ALIGN. Novartis (originated by Chinook Therapeutics).

clusters.label: Sibeprenlimab (APRIL inhibitor, Ph3)
clusters.description: Anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody in Phase 3 (VISIONARY) — targets the BAFF-family cytokine driving galactose-deficient IgA1 production. Otsuka (Visterra).

clusters.label: Atacicept (APRIL/BLyS inhibitor, Ph3)
clusters.description: Recombinant TACI-Fc fusion neutralizing APRIL and BLyS. Phase 3 ORIGIN. Vera Therapeutics.

clusters.label: Zigakibart (BION-1301, Ph3)
clusters.description: Anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody, Phase 3 BEYOND. Novartis (originated by Chinook).

clusters.label: Povetacicept (APRIL/BLyS, Ph3)
clusters.description: Dual APRIL/BLyS inhibitor (Fc-fusion). Phase 3 RAINIER. Alpine Immune Sciences (Vertex).

clusters.label: Telitacicept (China-approved)
clusters.description: BLyS/APRIL fusion protein approved in China for IgAN; not yet US/EU approved. RemeGen.

clusters.label: Narsoplimab (MASP-2 inhibitor)
clusters.description: Anti-MASP-2 monoclonal targeting the lectin complement pathway. Phase 3 ARTEMIS-IGAN. Omeros.

clusters.label: Felzartamab (anti-CD38, Ph2)
clusters.description: Anti-CD38 monoclonal targeting plasma cells producing pathogenic IgA. Phase 2 IGNAZ. Human Immunology Biosciences (HIBio) / MorphoSys originated.

clusters.label: Cemdisiran (C5 siRNA, Ph2)
clusters.description: Investigational siRNA suppressing hepatic complement C5. Phase 2 in IgAN. Alnylam.

clusters.label: Systemic corticosteroids (prednisone)
clusters.description: Oral or IV systemic glucocorticoids — methylprednisolone pulses, oral prednisone (the TESTING / STOP-IgAN regimens). Distinct from gut-targeted budesonide-ER.

clusters.label: Mycophenolate (off-label)
clusters.description: Mycophenolate mofetil used off-label for crescentic or progressive IgAN — controversial in Western trials, more accepted in Asian cohorts.

clusters.label: Cyclophosphamide (crescentic IgAN)
clusters.description: Alkylating immunosuppressant reserved for rapidly progressive / crescentic IgAN, usually with steroids.

clusters.label: Rituximab (off-label)
clusters.description: Anti-CD20 B-cell depletion tried off-label in refractory IgAN; mixed evidence.

clusters.label: Fish oil / omega-3
clusters.description: High-dose fish oil for IgAN — historical, low-cost adjunct mentioned in KDIGO; effect size debated.

clusters.label: Tonsillectomy
clusters.description: Tonsillectomy + steroid pulses — historically used in Japan and parts of Europe; rare in US practice.

clusters.label: Spironolactone / MRA
clusters.description: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists added for resistant hypertension or residual proteinuria.

clusters.label: IgA nephropathy (diagnosis)
clusters.description: Identification with IgA nephropathy / Berger's disease as the kidney diagnosis being lived with.

clusters.label: Gross / synpharyngitic hematuria
clusters.description: Visible blood in the urine, classically synpharyngitic — appearing within 1-3 days of an upper respiratory infection.

clusters.label: Microscopic hematuria
clusters.description: Blood detected on urinalysis or microscopy but not visible to the eye — often the first sign of IgAN.

clusters.label: Cola / tea / coke-colored urine
clusters.description: Surface descriptions of gross hematuria as cola, tea, coke, or rust-colored urine.

clusters.label: Proteinuria / foamy urine
clusters.description: Protein leak in IgAN — sub-nephrotic to nephrotic-range; foamy urine is the surface description.

clusters.label: Flank / loin pain
clusters.description: Loin or flank pain accompanying gross hematuria episodes — can be sharp or dull.

clusters.label: Edema / swelling
clusters.description: Lower-extremity, periorbital, or whole-body swelling from heavy proteinuria.

clusters.label: Hypertension (renal)
clusters.description: Elevated blood pressure driven by kidney involvement — usually the first dial of treatment.

clusters.label: Fatigue
clusters.description: Persistent fatigue — both from CKD progression and from treatment.

clusters.label: Chronic kidney disease (CKD)
clusters.description: Progressive loss of kidney function from IgAN, staged by eGFR.

clusters.label: Kidney failure / dialysis
clusters.description: End-stage kidney disease requiring renal replacement therapy — the outcome IgAN treatment is fighting to prevent.

clusters.label: Kidney transplant / recurrence
clusters.description: Transplantation as endpoint of IgAN — and recurrence of IgA deposits in the allograft (~30% by 10 years).

clusters.label: IgA vasculitis / Henoch-Schönlein
clusters.description: IgA vasculitis (formerly Henoch-Schönlein purpura) — the systemic vasculitic cousin of IgAN; same gd-IgA1 biology with skin / GI / joint involvement.

clusters.label: Anemia of CKD
clusters.description: Anemia from declining erythropoietin production in advanced IgAN-CKD.

clusters.label: Cardiovascular risk (CKD)
clusters.description: Elevated cardiovascular disease and stroke risk that travels with CKD from IgAN.

clusters.label: Secondary IgAN (cirrhosis / IBD / HIV)
clusters.description: Secondary IgA deposition associated with cirrhosis, inflammatory bowel disease (especially ulcerative colitis), HIV, celiac, or psoriasis.

clusters.label: Galactose-deficient IgA1 (pathogenesis)
clusters.description: The four-hit pathogenesis model: gd-IgA1 production → autoantibodies against gd-IgA1 → immune complexes → mesangial deposition and complement activation.

clusters.label: Kidney biopsy / Oxford MEST-C
clusters.description: Renal biopsy that confirms IgAN and grades it by the Oxford MEST-C score (Mesangial, Endocapillary, Segmental sclerosis, Tubular atrophy / interstitial fibrosis, Crescents).

clusters.label: eGFR / kidney function
clusters.description: Estimated glomerular filtration rate — the headline kidney-function measure tracked through IgAN.

clusters.label: Creatinine
clusters.description: Serum creatinine — derived input to eGFR, what bloodwork reports first.

clusters.label: UPCR / UACR / 24-hour urine
clusters.description: Urine protein-to-creatinine and albumin-to-creatinine ratios, plus 24-hour urine collections — the quantitative measure of proteinuria response.

clusters.label: Serum IgA / gd-IgA1 levels
clusters.description: Serum IgA elevation (~50% of patients) and emerging gd-IgA1 / anti-gd-IgA1 assays used in research / risk stratification.

clusters.label: Complement (C3 / C4)
clusters.description: Complement levels — usually normal in IgAN but tracked, with low C3 sometimes seen in active disease and informing complement-targeted therapy choice.

clusters.label: International IgAN Prediction Tool
clusters.description: The Barbour / IIgANPT risk calculator combining clinical and biopsy variables to predict 5-year ESRD risk — informs treatment intensity.

clusters.label: Diagnostic delay / incidental finding
clusters.description: IgAN often found incidentally on a routine physical, school sports physical, military medical, or pregnancy urinalysis — sometimes after years of microscopic hematuria dismissed as benign.

clusters.label: Diagnosis after URI
clusters.description: Story arc of diagnosis triggered by visible hematuria during or shortly after a respiratory or GI infection.

clusters.label: Proteinuria response
clusters.description: Falling UPCR / UACR as the primary felt sign that treatment is working in IgAN.

clusters.label: eGFR stabilization
clusters.description: Stabilized or improved kidney function on treatment — the goal beyond proteinuria reduction.

clusters.label: Quality of life (IgAN)
clusters.description: Felt impact of stable disease — getting back to running, work, normal energy.

clusters.label: Budesonide ER side effects
clusters.description: Targeted-release-budesonide side effects: weight gain, moon face, acne, mood changes, blood-sugar elevation — milder than systemic prednisone but not absent.

clusters.label: Sparsentan: hypotension / edema
clusters.description: Sparsentan-specific side-effect signal — low blood pressure, dizziness, fluid retention; REMS for hepatotoxicity / teratogenicity.

clusters.label: Iptacopan: infection / vaccination
clusters.description: Required meningococcal / pneumococcal / Hib vaccination before iptacopan because complement inhibition raises encapsulated-organism infection risk.

clusters.label: Systemic steroid burden
clusters.description: Side effects of systemic prednisone courses — weight gain, mood, blood sugar, infection — the burden Tarpeyo and the newer agents were designed to escape.

clusters.label: Drug cost / specialty pharmacy
clusters.description: The post-2021 wave of IgAN drugs are expensive specialty agents — prior authorization, copay assistance, and specialty pharmacy logistics come up.

clusters.label: Access to nephrology / specialty center
clusters.description: Distance to a nephrologist or to a center comfortable with the new IgAN agents — geography drives who gets sparsentan vs. who stays on RASi.

clusters.label: Avoiding dialysis goal
clusters.description: Preventing progression to dialysis or transplant as the central motivation behind IgAN treatment decisions.

clusters.label: Add-on to RASi / SGLT2i decision
clusters.description: The decision of when to add a second / third agent on top of optimized RASi + SGLT2i — and which: targeted budesonide, sparsentan, atrasentan, iptacopan, or a trial drug.

clusters.label: Pregnancy planning with IgAN
clusters.description: Switching off RASi / sparsentan / iptacopan and planning around pregnancy — preeclampsia risk and proteinuria flares can worsen in pregnancy.

clusters.label: Home BP monitoring
clusters.description: Home blood-pressure tracking — strict targets (often <125/75) are central to slowing IgAN.

clusters.label: Low-sodium / renal diet
clusters.description: Sodium restriction (and sometimes protein modulation) — practical lever patients control between visits.

clusters.label: Self-tracking urine / labs
clusters.description: At-home dipsticks, tracking labs in a spreadsheet, watching for foam in the toilet — high engagement with monitoring is common in IgAN.

clusters.label: Young adult diagnosis
clusters.description: Most patients are diagnosed in their 20s-40s and look healthy — the gap between feeling fine and being told you have a progressive kidney disease.

clusters.label: Invisible kidney disease
clusters.description: The challenge of a slow, mostly silent disease — feeling fine while labs trend the wrong way, or feeling sick while labs look stable.

clusters.label: Fear of progression
clusters.description: The chronic anxiety of watching eGFR trend down or waiting for the next biopsy / lab.
variants: what if i lose my kidneys

clusters.label: Work / school disruption
clusters.description: Specialist visits, labs, fatigue, and (in advanced disease) dialysis logistics interfering with work or school.

clusters.label: IgAN / kidney advocacy
clusters.description: NephCure, IgA Nephropathy Foundation of America, National Kidney Foundation, American Kidney Fund — patient-community and advocacy presence.

clusters.label: Proteinuria as surrogate endpoint
clusters.description: The accelerated-approval pathway built on UPCR reduction as a reasonably-likely-to-predict-benefit surrogate — the regulatory frame behind Tarpeyo / Filspari / Vanrafia accelerated approvals and the confirmatory eGFR-slope readouts.

clusters.label: eGFR slope endpoint
clusters.description: Annualized eGFR-slope decline as the confirmatory / hard endpoint in IgAN trials — what regulators want to see after the proteinuria readout.

clusters.label: Biopsy required for trial entry
clusters.description: Most IgAN trials require recent biopsy-confirmed disease (often within 5-10 years) and minimum proteinuria (UPCR ≥ 0.7-1.0 g/g) — common eligibility-screen sticking points.

clusters.label: Pipeline awareness
clusters.description: Patient-side awareness of the wave of post-2021 approvals and ongoing Ph3 readouts — Tarpeyo, Filspari, Fabhalta, Vanrafia, plus sibeprenlimab / atacicept / zigakibart / povetacicept.
